scope: Selective dispatch hydration and section invalidation; existing callable and source triggers

protocol.compatibility: Omitting sections retains the legacy full response, including GPS hydration. Explicit requests return only selected groups and acknowledge only selected markers read before business hydration.
protocol.jobs: One bounded active-delivery page, exact joined orders and one whole-scope count. Includes assignment binding and OTP deadline. Explicit section requests do not read any GPS storage.
protocol.roster: At most 100 profiles, exact enabled-profile availability batches of 30, and one whole-scope active count per selected enabled driver.
protocol.config: One config marker and one configuration document, after the existing admin check.
protocol.signals: Only the current Vietnam-day aggregate, after the existing admin check. No section marker is required for direct daily-counter subscription.

invalidation.jobs: Order and delivery changes, including delivery ordering-key changes.
invalidation.roster: Availability/lastSeenAt, displayed shipper profile fields, and changes to a delivery's active-count membership or assigned driver.
invalidation.profile: Reuse syncStudent360Profile. Unrelated user changes perform zero delivery IO; no additional all-users trigger is created.
invalidation.replay: Existing monotonic commit-time transactions suppress duplicate or out-of-order marker writes.
invalidation.addedMarkerWrites: At most one jobs marker per relevant order/delivery event and one roster marker when its inputs change. GPS writes trigger neither.

cases: Selected read budgets and omitted fields
Invalid input, revoked access and unavailable requested data
Selective source routing, replay and profile-trigger wiring
Exact admin-only reads, no lists or writes, missing documents and current-profile revocation

release.prerequisite: Verify PR24 backend and PR25 frontend before this separate scoped release; deploy all section sources and rules before switching dispatch UI.

remaining: Dispatch UI still uses its existing 30-second full refresh until the follow-up client is deployed.
The existing 100-profile cap and 100-job default remain; limitReached/page metadata do not establish a complete roster.
Count aggregation fan-out occurs on roster changes; a later measured contribution model may replace it.
Fixture operation counts exclude billed index/rules units and do not prove currency savings.
